[/size][/color][size=3]Description[/size]
I noticed Siv updated her [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/sivs-marriage-mod-v1-2-1-heart-events-fixed.109678/]Marriage Mod[/url] (Bless you, great Siv !) and since I've wanted to mod Willy's portrait for a long time, I thought "let's do this !" ! Willy is now younger but not too young either. I wanted him to still give off that mature man look.

I might do the other bachelors / bachelorettes added by Siv's mod.
(Clint, Gus, Lewis, Linus, Marnie, Pam, Sandy and The Wizard)
